description: Permissions for a detached sidebar panel's webview. Without an entry here a webview has NO permissions at all — not even `core:event` — so its `listen`/`emit` calls reject, it never hears the workbench's context broadcast, and it can never tell the workbench to dock it back; that is the same bug the editor window's capability file documents. Scoped like the git and editor windows': `core:event` and the window controls the panel draws in its own title bar, plus the dialog plugin for the file tree's own pickers and confirmations. No `fs:*` — the file tree reads through this app's own Rust commands, not the fs plugin — and no `core:webview:*`, because a panel never spawns child webviews. Grants `core:window:allow-destroy` alongside `allow-close`, and the pair is not redundant: `close()` only *requests* a close, and tauri prevents it outright for any window that has a JS `tauri://close-requested` listener — which this window has, because closing it is how it asks to be docked back. `onCloseRequested` then finishes the job with `destroy()`, so without this permission the window could not be closed at all, by the traffic light or by the workbench. See `close_satellite` in `src-tauri/src/window.rs`.
